24.title: Jamie Raskin on John Eastman: No evidence that he was acting as Trump's attorney
24.description:
John Eastman has claimed attorney-client privilege to attempt to conceal records from the Select Committee’s investigation.

"The problem is that there was no evidence that he was acting as the president's attorney or that they formed an attorney-client relationship." -Rep. Jamie Raskin
